text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! The academy's Florence Nightingale 
gave me a strict warning that overdoing it 
is strictly forbidden.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you're all exaggerating, 
including you. Any pain is merely a 
trivial matter to me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes... both the pain of being torn apart 
by an icy blade, and the pain of being 
scorched by blazing flames... right?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But I shall not bend the knee. Rather, 
I feel like expressing that very resolve 
through an opera!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! Let us dance! Now is the time 
to devise a brand new opera!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tales of my valor in confronting hardship 
inspire everyone... and of course, myself 
as well.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I'll turn this pain into my driving 
force. ...Trainer, let's hurry to the 
dance studio!"
choice_data_list: No good, everyone will be worried.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I'll turn this pain into my driving 
force. ...Trainer, let's hurry to the 
dance studio!"
choice_data_list: No good, everyone will be worried.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...You're saying that an act meant to 
cheer everyone up will end up bringing 
them to tears?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... If you put it that way, I have no 
choice but to step down. After all, I am a 
King who enchants the world with 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunate, but it can't be helped. I 
suppose I'll go reread some old scripts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reluctantly, T.M. Opera O lay down in 
bed... dedicated to getting some rest and 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't quite get the theory, but let's 
bet on her motivation...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My wings reaching for the heavens have 
been wounded... A swan taking flight... If 
that is so, what I must dance is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
choice_data_list: D-Didn't you just twist your ankle!?
D-Didn't you just twist your ankle!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Strength is a double-edged sword... Yet, 
that too... is a form... of beauty."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A momentary lapse in focus caused her to 
twist her ankle. She collapsed in pain... 
and took some time to recover.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Perfect! Moving just like a swan 
powerfully taking flight from a lakeside!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How about that? You can't even tell I was 
injured, can you? This is my opera!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Bwahaha! Just watch from 
right there, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The moment the grandest epic, the greatest 
masterpiece opera in my history is born!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She danced without letting any sign of 
injury show... and resumed her training 
immediately afterward—!
